greet.text: Roll up, roll up! Busker Lyle, entertainer to crowds and occasional pigeons. Come festival season I pay top coin for anything that makes an audience gasp.

choices.label: Sell a butterfly for the fair — 35 💎

effects.missingText: No butterflies on you! The fair crowd waits for no one — get netting.
effects.successText: Released at the crescendo of his act — the crowd GASPS. 'Magnifique!' 35 crystals, fair rates.

greet.text: The academy's lepidoptery cabinet is a disgrace — half the drawers are empty. I pay 20 crystals per specimen, humanely netted, no questions about technique.

effects.missingText: You have no specimens. The Net Loft in Saltmere Port sells catching nets; the orchards flutter with subjects.
effects.successText: Exquisite wing condition! Into the cabinet it goes. 20 crystals for science.

greet.text: My famous coronation breakfast platter needs two fresh eggs and a good smoked herring — and my suppliers have vanished into the festival crowds. Bring me the makings and I'll pay 45 crystals a platter.

effects.missingText: That's not a full platter's worth. Two eggs — the hens oblige anyone with feed — and a smoked herring from the Saltmere fish market.
effects.successText: Eggs, herring — perfect. The nobles will weep with joy. 45 crystals, and worth every one.

choices.label: I'll see what I can find.

greet.text: Everyone at court gifts jewels — how tediously predictable. Do you know what nobody has ever given me? Poetry. Dreadful, heartfelt, handwritten poetry.

effects.missingText: You pat your pockets and find no verse. The capital's own archivist writes the worst poetry in the realm — he trades it for feathers.
effects.successText: She reads a stanza, laughs until she cries, and clutches it to her heart. 'It's HORRIBLE. I adore it.' She presses 20 crystals on you and watches you leave.

greet.text: Blast and bother — third quill snapped this morning! How is a man to finish his verse cycle when the instruments betray him? I'd trade one of my published volumes for a single decent feather.

effects.missingText: You pat your pack theatrically, but there's no feather in it. The hens of the realm may be able to help.
effects.successText: He whittles it to a nib on the spot, eyes shining. 'Magnificent! Here — my collected verse. Treasure it.' You are now holding a book of genuinely awful poetry.

greet.text: Coronation orders are burying me and my egg baskets are empty by noon. If you've fresh eggs, I'll pay 20 crystals for every three.

effects.missingText: Fewer than three eggs in that pack. The palace hens are generous to anyone with feed.
effects.successText: He candles each one against the oven light and nods. 'Fine eggs. 20 crystals, and come back with more!'

quests.title: The Royal Census
quests.offerDialogue: The survey of the outer provinces is missing three scrolls — dropped by careless couriers somewhere in the city. Without them, the census is a work of fiction. Find them, please.
quests.activeDialogue: Three survey scrolls, somewhere in the streets. Check near the gates and the market.
quests.completeDialogue: All three, and barely smudged! The census lives. You have done the kingdom's paperwork a great service.

quests.title: The City Charter
quests.offerDialogue: Crownhaven's founding charter must be re-sealed for the coronation. Three wax seals were sent out for signing and never returned. Recover them before the ceremony.
quests.activeDialogue: Three charter seals, scattered among the districts. The clerks are hopeless.
quests.completeDialogue: The charter is whole again. The coronation may proceed with the law on its side. The crown thanks you.

quests.title: The Missing Ledgers
quests.offerDialogue: The treasury ledgers have gone astray — three of them. Banker Sterling will have my head if the accounts don't balance by dusk. Find them and take them to the Grand Bank.
quests.activeDialogue: Three ledgers, lost between the senate and the bank. Sterling is waiting.
quests.completeDialogue: Balanced to the last crystal. Sterling will sleep easy, and so will the crown's accountants.

collectible.name: Crown Ledger
collectible.desc: The reconciled treasury ledger of Crownhaven.

quests.title: The Herald's Proclamations
quests.offerDialogue: The wind stole two of my proclamation scrolls clean off the board. A herald with no words is just a loud nuisance. Fetch them back?
quests.activeDialogue: Two proclamation scrolls, blown somewhere down the plaza.
quests.completeDialogue: My voice is restored! The capital shall hear its decrees after all. Bless you.

quests.title: A Monument for the Square
quests.offerDialogue: The Chancellor wants two commemorative plaques set on the new plaza monument. Gather them, then bring them to the senate for inscription.

activeDialogue.plaques: Two commemorative plaques — one was left at the cathedral, one at the academy.
activeDialogue.hand: Both plaques? Splendid. Carry them to the Chancellor at the senate.

quests.completeDialogue: Inscribed and mounted. Crownhaven will remember this coronation for a hundred years.

quests.title: The Postern Key
quests.offerDialogue: One of my watchmen dropped the old postern gate key on patrol last night. Find it before someone less honest does, and leave it with Rosalind at The Gilded Goose.

activeDialogue.key: The key went missing somewhere along the east wall, near the cathedral. Look sharp.
activeDialogue.deliver: You found it? Good. Now get it to Rosalind at the inn, quiet-like.

quests.completeDialogue: From Captain Hale? Say no more. It'll be under the counter until shift change. Here, for your discretion.

quests.title: Walking the Walls
quests.offerDialogue: New patrol tokens need distributing to the wall posts. Collect the three I've had struck and run them out to Guardsman Bryn on the south wall.

activeDialogue.tokens: Three patrol tokens, left at the guard posts around the city.
activeDialogue.deliver: Got all three? Bryn's pacing the south wall. He'll be glad of them.

quests.completeDialogue: Tokens received. The watch runs like clockwork again. The Captain chose his runner well.

quests.title: The Coronation Cutpurse
quests.offerDialogue: A cutpurse has been working the coronation crowds. We found his dropped purse of stolen goods — recover it and bring the evidence to the Captain.

activeDialogue.purse: The stolen purse was dropped near the market in the scuffle. Find it.
activeDialogue.deliver: Evidence in hand? Take it straight to Captain Hale at the barracks.

quests.completeDialogue: Caught red-handed thanks to you. Crownhaven's purses are a little safer tonight.

quests.title: Steel for the Watch
quests.offerDialogue: The watch armoury is bare. I've four blades nearly finished — gather the steel billets I left cooling about the forge yard and I'll deliver the Captain his edge.
quests.activeDialogue: Four steel billets, somewhere around the Guard Quarter. Mind the heat.
quests.completeDialogue: Sharp work. Take these to the Captain with my compliments — the watch owes you.

quests.title: The Scattered Relics
quests.offerDialogue: Three holy relics were hidden away during the troubles and never recovered. The cathedral feels hollow without them. Will you search?
quests.activeDialogue: Three relics, hidden across the Temple Quarter and beyond.
quests.completeDialogue: All three, home at last. The cathedral breathes again. Bless you, child.

quests.title: The Dawn Blessing
quests.offerDialogue: For the coronation dawn we need three blessed candles set about the nave. They were left to cool at the chandler's stalls. Gather them, would you?
quests.activeDialogue: Three blessed candles, left around the market and plaza.
quests.completeDialogue: The nave glows as it should. The dawn blessing will be radiant. Take this with my thanks.

collectible.name: Dawn Reliquary
collectible.desc: A gilded reliquary blessed at the Crownhaven dawn rite.

quests.title: The Silent Bell
quests.offerDialogue: The great bell has hung silent for years — its clapper was lost. Recover it and take it to Smith Dunn, who alone can re-hang it.

activeDialogue.clapper: The bell clapper was last seen near the forge in the Guard Quarter.
activeDialogue.deliver: You have it? Take it to Dunn at the forge — he'll know what to do.

quests.completeDialogue: Listen — the bell tolls again over Crownhaven! Dunn says the tower is yours to climb now.

quests.title: Vigil in the Crypt
quests.offerDialogue: The crypt vigil requires two lanterns kept burning through the night. They were borrowed and never returned. Find them and the vigil can be kept.
quests.activeDialogue: Two vigil lanterns, somewhere in the Temple Quarter.
quests.completeDialogue: The vigil is kept and the dead rest easy. You have a quiet strength, child.

quests.title: Silks for the Coronation
quests.offerDialogue: Three bolts of imported silk were left about the market when the cart overturned. Gather them so I can dress the court in time.
quests.activeDialogue: Three silk bolts, lost around the Grand Market.
quests.completeDialogue: Exquisite. The court will shimmer. You've a good eye — here, a little something.

quests.title: Rough Diamonds
quests.offerDialogue: Three raw gems spilled from my pouch in the crowd. Dull little pebbles to most eyes — find them before someone kicks them down a drain.
quests.activeDialogue: Three raw gems, scattered across the plaza and market.
quests.completeDialogue: There's the fire I was after! Cut and polished, these will crown a duchess. Take a card for your trouble.

quests.title: The Apothecary's Remedy
quests.offerDialogue: I'm short three rare herbs for a coronation tonic the Chancellor swears by. They grow wild about the city's edges. Gather them?
quests.activeDialogue: Three rare herbs, growing around Riverside and the Temple Quarter.
quests.completeDialogue: Perfect potency. The Chancellor will be insufferably energetic. Take my compendium — you've earned it.

collectible.name: Apothecary's Compendium
collectible.desc: Apothecary Mads' annotated book of Crownhaven remedies.

quests.title: The King's Loaf
quests.offerDialogue: Three sacks of milling grain went missing off my cart. Find them and run them to Matron Goldie at the market — she's holding my oven's worth of orders hostage.
quests.activeDialogue: Three grain sacks, lost between the market and the mill road.
quests.completeDialogue: Grain at last! Tell Otto his loaf is saved. And here — a little something for the legwork.

quests.title: Market Day Muddle
quests.offerDialogue: Three purses of takings got knocked off my stall in the coronation rush. Forty years and I've never lost a copper — until today. Help an old woman out?
quests.activeDialogue: Three coin purses, dropped around the Grand Market.
quests.completeDialogue: Every copper back where it belongs. You're a rare honest soul. Don't tell the pigeons.

quests.title: The Crownhaven Anthology
quests.offerDialogue: A three-volume anthology of the realm's history was scattered ages ago. The first tome surfaced in the library stacks, if my notes are right.

activeDialogue.tome-1: The first tome is in the library stacks. Look on the shelves.
activeDialogue.tome-2: Excellent! The second volume was lent to the academy. Check there.
activeDialogue.tome-3: Almost there! The final volume ended up near the cathedral, I believe.

quests.completeDialogue: The trilogy is whole! This is extraordinary scholarship. Please, take this anthology as thanks.

collectible.name: Crownhaven Anthology
collectible.desc: A complete three-volume history of the capital.

quests.title: Scattered Lectures
quests.offerDialogue: My lecture notes blew across three districts during a window mishap. Gather them before a student finds them and learns something dangerous.
quests.activeDialogue: Three bundles of lecture notes, scattered across the city.
quests.completeDialogue: All present and correct! The next generation of clever fools is saved. My thanks.

quests.title: A Delicate Experiment
quests.offerDialogue: The academy needs two volatile reagents from the apothecary's stock, but they must be carried carefully. Gather them and deliver them to Mads — gently.
quests.activeDialogue: Two reagents, set out around the academy and market. Don't shake them.
quests.completeDialogue: Intact! Marvellous. Tell Fenwick his experiment lives — and take a card for steady hands.

quests.title: The Mint Dies
quests.offerDialogue: Two coining dies went missing from the mint floor — in the wrong hands they could forge the realm's coin. Recover both before word gets out.
quests.activeDialogue: Two mint dies, lost about the Guard Quarter.
quests.completeDialogue: Both dies, safe. You've spared the treasury a forger's nightmare. Quietly done — I like that.

quests.title: The Vault Breach
quests.offerDialogue: A pouch of newly minted coin was lifted from the vault antechamber. Recover it and take it to Captain Hale — the watch must know we were breached.

activeDialogue.pouch: The stolen coin pouch was dropped in the getaway, near the bank.
activeDialogue.deliver: Recovered? Take it to Captain Hale at the barracks at once.

quests.completeDialogue: The watch has the evidence and the vault is sealed once more. With the breach closed, the vault is open to you.

quests.title: A Noble Debt
quests.offerDialogue: Two promissory notes of mine must reach the Grand Bank discreetly before they fall due. Carry them to Banker Sterling for me, would you?
quests.activeDialogue: Two promissory notes, to be gathered and taken to the bank.
quests.completeDialogue: Settled, and not a whisper of scandal. You have a noblewoman's gratitude — and perhaps a little more.

quests.title: Lady Cora's Locket
quests.offerDialogue: My mother's locket broke and scattered in three pieces across the gardens and squares. It is all I have of her. Please — find them.
quests.activeDialogue: Three locket pieces, lost across the districts.
quests.completeDialogue: Whole again, and so is my heart. You cannot know what this means. Bless you, traveller.

quests.title: The Busker's Strings
quests.offerDialogue: Snapped three lute strings and they pinged off who-knows-where across the plaza. No strings, no coronation song. Help a poor musician?
quests.activeDialogue: Three lute strings, sprung loose around the plaza and market.
quests.completeDialogue: Re-strung and ready! Crownhaven shall have its anthem after all. Here — a card from a grateful bard.

quests.title: A Round on the House
quests.offerDialogue: The coronation crowd drank me out of clean mugs and three rolled off who-knows-where. Round them up and the next ale's on me.
quests.activeDialogue: Three tankards, lost around the inn and market.
quests.completeDialogue: Spotless and accounted for! You're always welcome at the Goose. First ale's free, mind.

quests.title: The Coronation Feast
quests.offerDialogue: The coronation feast needs four crates of provisions gathered from the market and run to Baker Otto, who's coordinating the kitchens. Big night, big appetite.

activeDialogue.provisions: Four crates of provisions, scattered about the Grand Market.
activeDialogue.hand: All four? Take them to Otto at the bakery — the feast depends on it.

quests.completeDialogue: The feast is saved and the capital will dine like royalty. Otto sends his thanks — and so do I.

collectible.name: Coronation Feast Menu
collectible.desc: The grand menu of the Crownhaven coronation feast.

quests.title: Word to Ravenwatch
quests.offerDialogue: Crownhaven's charter must be copied to Ravenwatch's elder for the old records. Take this sealed copy across the realm and place it in the Elder's hands yourself.
quests.activeDialogue: Carry the charter copy to the Elder of Ravenwatch.
quests.completeDialogue: From Crownhaven's Chancellor? The old bonds hold firm. Tell Vell the records are kept. Safe travels, friend.

collectible.name: Royal Charter Copy
collectible.desc: A sealed copy of Crownhaven's charter, witnessed in Ravenwatch.

quests.title: A Relic Returned
quests.offerDialogue: One of our recovered relics belongs by right to Ravenwatch's keep. Bear it to Guard-Captain Thorin there, and let the two cities be at peace over it.
quests.activeDialogue: Bear the relic to Guard-Captain Thorin in Ravenwatch.
quests.completeDialogue: Crownhaven returns what was borrowed? Thorin accepts it gladly. The realm is the stronger for it.

quests.title: A Trusted Blade
quests.offerDialogue: You've earned more than the watch's thanks, traveller — you've earned my trust, and that's not given lightly in Crownhaven. Stand with me a moment. There's something I want you to have.
quests.activeDialogue: No rush. The gates have stood longer than either of us.
quests.completeDialogue: There. Not many earn a captain's trust — you have. The watch will remember it.

quests.title: Off the Wall
quests.offerDialogue: You. I've had my fill of you loitering near my post. Fine — make yourself useful for once and report back when you have.
quests.activeDialogue: Well? The wall isn't getting any shorter while I wait.
quests.completeDialogue: About time. Here — take it and find somewhere else to loiter.

rival.1: Spending time up at the mint again? Every coin that leaves Coyle's hammer still has to pass through my ledger, traveller. Don't let his pageantry fool you about who really keeps this city solvent.
